snippet.title: XENOH: DYNAMIC BOUT - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
XENOH: DYNAMIC BOUT is an over-the-top, bone-crunching 2D fighting game where thirteen larger-than-life fighters vie for supremacy! Dash Counters, Crash Hits, and one-button special actions deliver classic, fast, and fun arcade fighting action! 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5326520/XENOH_DYNAMIC_BOUT/

Developer: PROJECT ATSUKI
